Name: King Asa
Summary: Asa was a good king of Judah who removed idols, renewed the covenant, and trusted God against a vast Cushite army. His later years sadly turned from seeking the Lord.
KeyStory: Outnumbered, Asa cried to God that there is no one like Him to help the powerless, and God struck down the Cushites before Judah.
LifeLesson: Asa's cry is a perfect prayer for the overwhelmed: Lord, help the powerless. Bring Him your impossible odds — He specialises in battles you cannot win alone.
